content.short: TonUp is a TON launch and discovery platform for finding, supporting, and showcasing high-potential ecosystem projects.
content.description: TonUp is a launch and discovery platform focused on The Open Network. Its positioning is to identify promising TON projects, showcase new opportunities to the community, and help early teams reach users and market attention. The registry places it near launchpads and venture support because its value is ecosystem growth: connecting projects, users, capital, and visibility rather than offering a wallet, game, or DEX itself. That makes it useful for teams preparing launches and for users looking for new TON projects.
